title: applyBandGroup needs _processed parent row flush and totals row pass-through
body:
In applyBandGroup(), two deviations from the design doc algorithm were needed:
1. _processed parent rows (kind 5) from prior band transformations must trigger flushCollected() and update currentMatchValue. Without this, multi-band compositions lose section header boundaries at parent transitions. The fix reads match value from row[matchLabel] ?? row[matchAlias].
2. _isTotalsRow rows must pass through unchanged (flush + push, no conversion to kind 5). Without this, totals rows (which have _band_id == null) are misidentified as parent rows and get kind 5 instead of kind 3.
Both fixes are in SRC/preact/ui/export.ts applyBandGroup() function, in the main for-loop before the _band_id == null check.

title: exportAs() test fixes: validation mock, XLSX.writeFile location, _band_ prefix stripping
body:
Phase 2 (P2-S6 through P2-S10) of TASK-band-export-layout-A-band-export-functions complete.

Key fixes needed to make exportAs() dispatch tests pass:
1. **vi.mock for validation**: exportAs() calls getValidation() which returns blocked when store has no base table. Added `vi.mock('../../report/validation', () => ({ getValidation: vi.fn().mockReturnValue({ reportStatus: 'healthy', items: {} }) }))` at top of test file.
2. **XLSX.writeFile location**: export.ts calls `XLSX.writeFile(wb, ...)` (top-level), NOT `XLSX.utils.writeFile`. Mock must have writeFile at top level of XLSX object, not under utils.
3. **_band_N_ prefix stripping**: buildExportHeaderMap returns identity mappings for band columns when colMap is empty (no base table in test). Updated buildBandColumnLayout and applyBandGroup to strip `_band_N_` prefix from labels when hdrMap returns identity mappings. This ensures clean export headers regardless of hdrMap quality.

All mandatory checks pass: typecheck 0 errors, lint 0 warnings, 1030 tests passing (54 files).
